scoring_justification: Adsorption energies are final results of a detailed classical simulation that cannot be recomputed in the verifier. Scoring compares reported energies to hidden paper gold with tolerance and checks physical trends.

outputs.description: Six adsorption energies (in eV) for LiF monomer, rhombic dimer, linear dimer on terrace and at [10-1] step.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold adsorption energies from paper Tables 3 and 5
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Copied from paper Tables 3 and 5 (main quantitative results)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported values for the main reproduction target, the same quantities the agent must compute.

steps.description: Score six adsorption energies against hidden gold and verify trends
